beats.say: Four well-known stocks jumped ten percent or more on Monday. The biggest of them: a geothermal company with a Google power deal.

visual.label: Monday close: biggest of four
visual.question: Four well-known stocks jumped 10%+ on Monday.

beats.say: Number four. NRG Energy rose ten percent, after agreeing to sell six gas power plants for four billion dollars.

visual.reason: Agreed to sell six gas plants for $4B

beats.say: Number three. AMD rose thirteen percent, after an Oppenheimer upgrade and a Google Cloud chip pick.
Number two. QXO rose nineteen percent, after preliminary third quarter sales jumped seventy nine percent.
And number one, Fervo Energy, up twenty six percent, after its quarterly report showed contracted revenue of eleven point nine billion dollars.
